subject: CardioScale: Close→Success playbook, owners, and immediate next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@cardioscale.com>, Procurement <procurement@cardioscale.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: CardioScale: Close→Success playbook, owners, and immediate next steps

Team — wrapping up the close and moving this into CS. Key context up front: CardioScale signed SOW yesterday for our Dedicated plan (3 GPUs reserved, 12-month commit). They plan to ingest live telemetry and anonymized EHR snippets; primary POC is Sara Thomas (CTO). High-level asks from the deal: sub-10ms p99 for inference on 512-token windows, SOC2 evidence review, and a 30-day pilot with acceptance gates. Procurement copied for billing/start date alignment.

What I need from CS (owners below):
- Primary onboarding lead (owner of kickoff + SOW milestones)
- Network/security intake owner to drive firewall/VPC mapping and SOC2 artifacts
- Delivery timeline for Pilot start (target: 2028-07-25)

Attachments: CardioScale_MutualActionPlan_20280711.xlsx (mutual action plan / milestones), Signed_SOW_v2.pdf

Recommended owners (volunteer if you disagree):
- Onboarding lead: Marissa Cole
- Security intake: Monica Patel
- Staging/runbook & infra liaison: Vivek Kulkarni
- Success exec / 90-day outcomes: Tessa Morgan

Sara / CardioScale — feel free to add anything I'm missing. Internal team: please reply with any changes to owners or timing by EOD so I can confirm with Procurement.

—Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@cardioscale.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@cardioscale.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: CardioScale: Close→Success playbook, owners, and immediate next steps

Thanks Jordan — quick clarifications from our side:
- Pilot scope confirmed: model inferencing only (no training), ingest from our Kafka topic, and store embeddings in our own DB.
- Data classification: telemetry = non-PHI; EHR snippets = sensitive (we will provide redacted samples).
- Security: SOC2 report available; procurement wants a current cert and a short questionnaire answered.

One ask: can we get a staging environment and a simple perf test harness by the start of pilot? That'll help our acceptance gate for p99.

I'll circle up procurement on dates once you confirm owners.

—Sara
CTO, CardioScale
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@cardioscale.com>, Procurement <procurement@cardioscale.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 11:15:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: CardioScale: Close→Success playbook, owners, and immediate next steps

Thanks — happy to take the onboarding lead.
Immediate plan (owners assigned):
1) Kickoff & milestones (owner: Marissa) — schedule kickoff w/in 3 business days after owners confirmed. Draft agenda: goals, success criteria, acceptance gates, SOW milestones, preliminary runbook.
2) Security intake & SOC2 artifacts (owner: Monica) — Monica will request the CardioScale questionnaire and SOC2 from Sara; we'll map gaps and record required evidence in the MAM attachment.
3) Staging infra & perf harness (owner: Vivek) — Vivek will stand up a staging slot and provide a simple perf test (kafka -> model -> metrics) no later than 2028-07-22.
4) Customer success outcomes & check-ins (owner: Tessa) — Tessa will operate the 30/60/90 plan and acceptance checklist.

Risks / open items:
- Firewall/VPC peering: need CardioScale network CIDR & egress rules (Sara: please share).
- Data residency: confirm where embeddings are stored and retention period (CardioScale controls storage).
- Pilot acceptance metrics: for acceptance we need a reproducible perf runbook and sample data.

Action items for Jordan: push procurement on start-of-billing date; we'll time the kickoff to align with resource readiness.

Attachment: updated row in CardioScale_MutualActionPlan_20280711.xlsx with owner columns filled.

—Marissa
Senior Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@cardioscale.com>, Procurement <procurement@cardioscale.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 09:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: CardioScale: Close→Success playbook, owners, and immediate next steps

Looping back with the security intake plan.
What I'll need from CardioScale by 2028-07-18:
- Current SOC2 report (PDF) and contact for attestation questions
- Network diagram + inbound/outbound rules and CIDR ranges for VPC peering
- Sample redacted EHR snippet for classification and a short data flow diagram

I'll open a shared secure folder and upload our questionnaire (technical & organizational controls). Please note: if any controls require additional engineering work (e.g., dedicated VPC connectors), we'll flag as a staging blocker for the pilot.

Vivek — I'll sync with you on credentials and the staging perf harness so we can reproduce the p99 runs.

Sara — can you confirm who from CardioScale will own the network artifacts? If Procurement prefers, we can send a one-page summary for legal showing encryption/in-transit controls.

—Monica
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@cardioscale.com>, Procurement <procurement@cardioscale.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 16:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: CardioScale: Close→Success playbook, owners, and immediate next steps

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick alignment. Summary of agreed next steps (I will update HubSpot and the MAM):
- Marissa to schedule kickoff with CardioScale by 2028-07-14 (owner: Marissa).
- Monica to request SOC2 + questionnaire; CardioScale to provide network diagram by 2028-07-18.
- Vivek to provision staging perf slot and deliver test harness by 2028-07-22.
- Tessa to publish 30/60/90 success checklist before kickoff.
- Jordan to confirm billing start date with Procurement and update deal record (deal CSD-2028-0481).

Sara — please reply to confirm the network contact or drop the artifacts in the Drive link above; we'll hold pilot to the acceptance gate once perf harness and SOC2 are validated.

If no objections, I'll close the loop and mark owners on the MAM.

—Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
